purpose: Scientific slice export of the verification vortex, separate from the production airfoil GUI
criteria: Coarse and fine slices use the same stated z plane; interpolate density and momentum in z, never silently use different cell centres
A known linear velocity field at constant density is reproduced on both slice grids to absolute tolerance 2e-13
Owned/virtual coarse masks, actual dx ratio 2, edge coordinates, background velocity and true synchronized time are saved
Saving a slice must not change the source PDFs or advance either clock
PNG and offline Pillow GIF are rendered from actual saved arrays with a common fixed colour scale and flat cell shading in x/y
Full acceptance run exports 21 increasing-time snapshots of the N=32 corner-vortex case from t=0 through t=80, and the GIF contains 21 frames
No extra dependencies, network download, browser or ffmpeg
